common.whatsappMessage: Hello Bayt Languages, I'd like to ask about a translation.

hero.title: Language is a bridge. We build it with craftsmanship.
hero.subtitle: Bayt Languages delivers certified, notarized, and specialist translations for individuals, businesses, and government bodies — reviewed by professional linguists and backed by a verifiable digital certificate on every document.

trust.title: Precision you can verify, service you can rely on

items.title: Certified & notarized
items.description: Every translation carries the classification it requires — certified, notarized, or sworn — recognized by the institutions that request it.

items.title: Human expertise
items.description: Legal, medical, academic, and business documents are matched with linguists who specialize in that exact domain.

items.title: Digital verification
items.description: Each delivered document ships with a QR-linked certificate confirming authenticity, translation dates, and file integrity.

items.title: Confidential by default
items.description: Your documents and identity are handled with strict confidentiality — visible only to the extent you choose.

services.title: Specialist translation across every domain that matters

items.title: Legal documents
items.description: Contracts, court rulings, powers of attorney, and legal correspondence, translated with terminological precision.

items.title: Medical records
items.description: Clinical reports, prescriptions, and medical histories, handled with the care patient records demand.

items.title: Academic credentials
items.description: Diplomas, transcripts, and research papers prepared for university admissions and accreditation bodies.

items.title: Business & commercial
items.description: Financial statements, agreements, and corporate documentation for cross-border business.

items.title: Government & personal
items.description: Birth certificates, identification documents, and immigration paperwork, certified for official use.

items.title: Notarized & sworn
items.description: Translations carrying the additional legal weight required by embassies, courts, and notaries.

process.title: From first message to verified certificate

steps.title: Message us on WhatsApp
steps.description: Send your document and agree on scope, languages, and timeline directly with our team.

steps.title: We translate & review
steps.description: A specialist translator and a second-pass reviewer complete your document to the classification you need.

steps.title: Receive your verified file
steps.description: Your translated PDF arrives with a scannable certificate — proof of authenticity, anytime, anywhere.

verification.title: Every translation, verifiable in seconds
verification.description: Scan the QR code on any Bayt Languages certificate to confirm document details, translation dates, and file integrity — instantly, from any device.

finalCta.title: Ready to get started?
finalCta.subtitle: Send us your document on WhatsApp and we'll take it from there.

hero.title: A translation house built on craft, not shortcuts
hero.subtitle: Bayt Languages was founded on a simple premise: a translation is only as good as the trust placed in it. Every document we deliver is reviewed, classified, and — where required — certified or notarized to the standard our clients' institutions expect.

items.title: Accuracy first
items.description: Every translation goes through specialist translation and independent review before delivery.

items.title: Transparency
items.description: Clear classification, clear timelines, and a verifiable certificate for every document we issue.

items.title: Confidentiality
items.description: Your documents are handled under strict confidentiality from the moment you send them to us.

hero.title: Translation services for every requirement
hero.subtitle: Whichever classification your document requires — standard, certified, notarized, or sworn — our process is built to deliver it correctly the first time.

hero.title: Let's talk about your document
hero.subtitle: The fastest way to reach us is WhatsApp. Send your file, and our team will confirm languages, timeline, and pricing directly with you.

contact.note: No forms, no accounts — just a conversation with our team.

verify.legalNoticeBody: This certificate confirms that the document described above was translated and issued by Bayt Languages. This verification page and its contents are provided for the sole purpose of confirming the authenticity of the translation. Any alteration of the translated document invalidates this verification. For questions regarding this certificate, please contact Bayt Languages directly.
